title: regional-priority-tranche-and-staggered-failover-venting
author: Asha Raman
body: Motivation: during multi-region overload incidents we observed rapid circuit flips and wholesale regional failovers that caused large customer-visible latency/timeout waves. This PR implements a regional 'priority tranche' mechanism plus a staggered failover venting path to reduce flapping and give SREs deterministic soft-capacity to breathe. Goals: 1) enforce per-tenant SLO budgets with a non-blocking tranche allocator, 2) add a staggered vent window so regions can shed low-priority tranches before triggering cross-region failover, 3) attach circuit snapshot markers so a node can rejoin at a warm state and avoid immediate re-eviction, 4) improve telemetry (per-tranche counters, reopen-rate histograms) for post-incident diagnosis. Changes: - Introduce TrancheAllocator service (policy-driven: emergency, standard, best-effort) wired into the SLO enforcer so requests are scored and placed into priority tranches. - Implement Staggered Vent Controller: on overload the controller progressively opens best-effort tranches with configurable backoff windows per-region to avoid simultaneous cross-region failover. - Add CircuitSnapshot metadata to the region health state to persist soft-eviction timestamps and recent reopen attempts; snapshot is used to apply exponential cool-down on reopen attempts. - Hotfix: KV drain path in the kv-sync worker to ensure in-flight caches aren't held during brief tranche reassignments (fixes a small leak observed in incident INC-1980). - Telemetry: new metrics (regional_tranche_allocations_total, tranche_reopen_rate, tranche_backoff_seconds) and a dashboard json (observability/dashboards/tranche-overview.json). Backwards compatibility: policy defaults are conservative so clusters without explicit config behave like before. Testing: unit tests for allocator heuristics; integration test simulating region overload with 3-stage venting; a canary rollout (10% traffic) executed during merge window. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear/ENG-8421) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Load test run against perf-lab (results attached) - [x] Telemetry dashboard added - [x] Documented config knobs in README and Console notes - [x] Hotfix KV drain patch included Related: RFC: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8421/tranche-routed-fallbacks and incident notes SUP-4401. Deployment plan: staged canary -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring alerts for tranche_reopen_rate > 0.5/s or regional_reopen_spike. Merge notes: squash-merged after CI rerun; feature behind runtime flag 'tranche_experimental' for 24h observation.

Staggered vent controller: orchestration + backoff window implementation
Circuit snapshot persistence + readback on node join
KV drain hotfix and unit tests
Integration test harness for simulated regional overload

review_comments: Jonah Lee: Overall design looks sound. Please extract backoff constants into a named config struct so we can tune without recompile.
Asha Raman: Addressed — moved constants to TrancheConfig and added runtime flag gating.
Priya Nair: Can you clarify how this interacts with existing tenant weight overrides? Concerned about double counting when both tranche and tenant-weight-based shedding are active.
Asha Raman: The allocator checks tenant-weight first and maps heavy tenants to upper tranches; added explicit unit tests and a doc note explaining precedence.
Tomás García: CI flaked on the integration test once; re-run passed. Approving pending CI green.
CI Bot: integration/regional_tranche_overload_test failed on first run (timeout). Re-run queued and passed.
merge_result: merged after CI re-run; feature behind runtime flag and rolled out to canary (10%) then 25% then full
release_notes: Introduce regional priority tranche and staggered venting to soften cross-region failovers. Includes KV drain hotfix and new tranche telemetry. Feature is off by default behind runtime flag 'tranche_experimental'.
